90043b845c.q: How do you generate leads from LinkedIn group polls without cold outreach?
90043b845c.a: By joining relevant LinkedIn groups like Sales Management Executives, conduct one business-specific poll per week asking about key challenges. Click on the vote counts to see every person who voted, review their profile headlines to identify ideal clients or business allies, then right-click and send personalized connection requests mentioning the specific poll they voted in. For example, a poll asking about the biggest disconnect between sales strategy and team execution generated 190 votes, allowing you to filter voters by their fit to your business.

04aa1e26c2.q: How can you identify and message warm leads from LinkedIn poll voters on your personal profile?
04aa1e26c2.a: When conducting a poll on your personal profile, voters who are your first-degree connections display a blue arrow icon pointing up to the right. Clicking this icon opens your LinkedIn DMs with the poll post included. You can then message them directly thanking them for voting and offering support, which is the warmest lead generation opportunity because they are already a connection and you are referencing an existing touchpoint.
